svg.title: Figure 5.6: The b07 T1′ tree and the missing certificate expansion
svg.desc: The tree of the b07 T1′ step drawn folded, with V′ expanded one level further than the runner records it: V′ by orbit in the cascade order, each orbit's three-cycle steps, each step as conjugator, seed and inverse conjugator
svg.text: Figure 5.6: The b07 T1′ tree and the missing certificate expansion
The committed flat V′ word has 139,774 letters. The certificate inventory names run2/03-b07-v-cert.json.gz, sha256
Data note: The certificate's contents are not committed. Its per-orbit cascade, three-cycle steps, conjugators and seeds
cannot be recovered from its checksum or flat word without new analysis. V′ stays folded at the runner's recorded boundary.
Committed research evidence · provisional colours · no Windows/DirectX or performance claim
